name: mediterranean-boat-besties-summer
image_vibe: carefree, friendly, relaxed Mediterranean summer memory
image_purpose: show authentic friendship and vacation relaxation on a boat

prompt.project_info: Natural travel lifestyle / Mediterranean vacation snapshot; spontaneous holiday photo, not a fashion or editorial shoot.
prompt.main_subject: Two generic approved adult women friends relaxing on a boat, clearly friends rather than romantic partners. One is blonde with a ponytail and dark sunglasses; the other has light brown hair and dark sunglasses. Preserve relaxed expressions, simple swimwear, and natural travel appearance.
prompt.composition_elements: Casual wide handheld travel framing. Two friends recline on white pillows over a netted lounging platform, with wooden boat beams and coiled rope visible. Clear turquoise sea and rocky Mediterranean coastline fill the background. Keep natural unposed interaction and realistic proportions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright soft natural daylight, clean reflections on calm turquoise water, natural shadows, carefree friendly holiday atmosphere without cinematic effects.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic travel snapshot, vertical composition, natural depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture, no artificial blur or editorial retouching.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic spontaneous Mediterranean boat vacation snapshot of two adult women friends relaxing on white pillows over a netted wooden boat platform, blonde ponytail and light-brown hair, dark sunglasses, casual swimwear, clear turquoise sea and rocky coastline, coiled rope and boat beams, friendly natural expressions, bright soft daylight, handheld travel framing, realistic texture and natural shadows.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, romantic intimacy, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: boat-friends-reference
assets.usage: Match the two-person friendship composition, boat net, turquoise sea, clothing simplicity, and relaxed vacation mood. Replaceable with another approved boat-friends image.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the two-adult-friends relationship, general identity cues, natural expressions, outfit category, boat environment, sea color, and composition; keep subjects generic and approved. Optional replacement references may change faces, hair, swimwear colors, or coastline while retaining the friendship, boat, and vacation story. No identity claims, logos, or typography.
